file_write.scope: Only write the keyword library, generated topic CSV, topic history, and atomic temporary files inside the user-selected local output directory.
file_write.reason: Local file writing is the core delivery path because this skill exports Excel-compatible CSV files and preserves local topic history for deduplication.

target_enforcement.openai: The skill instructions require an explicit local output directory; csv_store.py validates every generated filename remains inside it.
target_enforcement.claude: Not an advertised adapter target; any future adapter must preserve the same local output-directory boundary.
target_enforcement.generic: The neutral package uses the same local CLI and output-directory containment checks.
target_enforcement.vscode: Not an advertised adapter target; any future adapter must preserve the same local output-directory boundary.
